Department Responsibilities:
The Register of Deeds office is where all transactions dealing with land in our county are recorded. This office maintains and preserves these records so the public is made aware of their existance. Among the various documents recorded in this office are: deeds, mortgages, easements, surveys, death certificates, oil & gas leases, assignments and releases, tax liens, UCCs and military discharges. Fee Schedule The current fee schedule is availabe by clicking the link. ksrods.org This is your link to the Kansas State Register of Deeds. This links lists all county officials along with their addresses and phone numbers. This link also has forms you can copy, such as mortgage registration fee affidavit.
